xna-type.name: DepthFormat
xna-type.summary: Defines the format of data in a depth buffer.
xna-type.remarks: All depth-stencil formats except Depth16Lockable indicate no particular bit ordering per pixel, and the driver is allowed to consume more than the indicated number of bits per depth channel (but not stencil channel).

member.name: Depth15Stencil1
member.summary: A 16-bit depth-buffer bit depth in which 15 bits are reserved for the depth channel and 1 bit is reserved for the stencil channel.

member.name: Depth24
member.summary: A 32-bit depth-buffer bit depth that uses 24 bits for the depth channel.

member.name: Depth24Stencil4
member.summary: A 32-bit depth-buffer bit depth that uses 24 bits for the depth channel and 4 bits for the stencil channel.

member.name: Depth24Stencil8
member.summary: A nonlockable format that contains 24 bits of depth (in a 24-bit floating-point format − 20E4) and 8 bits of stencil.

member.name: Depth24Stencil8Single
member.summary: A 32-bit depth-buffer bit depth that uses 24 bits for the depth channel and 8 bits for the stencil channel.
